title: About me
bio: I’m a product designer with 4+ years of experience crafting user-centered SaaS platforms and AI-powered products that improve lives, meet business needs, and encourage tech adoption. I collaborate closely with multidisciplinary international teams and cross-functional stakeholders, leveraging systems thinking, conversational design, and WCAG-compliant accessibility standards to deliver scalable, inclusive, and high-quality user experiences.
Thanks for taking the time to get to know me, I look forward to get to know you too!

focus.heading: My focus
focus.body: In 2 words, tech and people. I strongly believe that technology should be as invisible as possible, working to enhance lives. That’s why I majored in industrial design, where I was eager to create consumer electronics, but eventually found my way into UX & UI design and fell in love with it. That’s where I realized the lasting impact that I can have through technology and software.

items.title: Good design
items.description: I am a firm believer of Dieter Ram’s 10 rules for good design, and they are specially important with products in the digital age.

items.title: Nature
items.description: I am one of those “Let’s go for a walk in nature” type of person, I love cold weather, dipping my feet on a river and feeling a morning breeze.

items.title: Movies
items.description: Have you ever watch “The secret life of Walter Mitty”? I love talking about movies, composition, directors, scripts and how impactful a story can be.

items.title: Philosophy
items.description: I’m a big fan of Marcus Aurelius' “Meditations” so I consider myself a student of stoicism, but most importantly, I believe the way is just to keep learning, acknowledging that we are all just students.

items.title: Food
items.description: You'll always hear me say "Let's grab a bite", and my favorite thing to do is go out for brunch and coffee.

items.title: Family
items.description: I'm always looking forward to hangout with my family, my partner and my dogs, I will bring them anywhere I can.
